rules.statement: PARA_RD_ID_COUNT, the number of read IDs in rotation, must default to 1 and be within the legal range 1..8.
The read ID width must remain 3 regardless of PARA_RD_ID_COUNT, and the count must not increase outstanding capacity.
PARA_WR_ID_COUNT, the number of write IDs in rotation, must default to 1 and be within the legal range 1..8.
The write ID width must remain 3 regardless of PARA_WR_ID_COUNT, and the count must not increase outstanding capacity.
AXI address, data and ID widths, FIFO depths and protocol features must not be user-overridable in this revision.
No USER sideband or USER-width parameters are defined.
Immediately above each RTL parameter, comments // Parameter Description, // Parameter values and // Parameter unit must appear in that order.
